name: native-measured-unit-identity
goal: Preserve source identities for every measured or removed unit after verification releases indexes

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Linux CI run 40421510002 failed attaching a verification record because benchmarked service.title was outside impact and its source files had been pruned before record assembly.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/verify-measures.e2e.test.ts checks metrics for impacted units but not source identities for a benchmarked non-impacted unit or a removed base unit; extend that standard fixture to assert both and attach the measured record.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The Desktop recorded-artifact fixture failed at 9cab783e5b73e130770a4e41cdd83d107fd5da69 because benchmarked service.title lost its committed source hash before attachment.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
